summary: Keep the disposable cluster lab seed bounded and clean up terminated guests

guide.reason: This changes only a contributor-owned disposable lab fixture, not an operator workflow.

api.reason: No Controller, Core, or client API path is changed; the fixture seeds test guests and cleans up its own processes.

roadmap.reason: The fixture fix does not establish any fencing acceptance gate.

state.reason: No Nex pool or Controller state changes; lab overlays remain disposable test artifacts.

verification.method: Two focused lab-fixture tests failed before the fix and passed after it; the first disposable lab run exposed the timeout and cleanup failure. A replacement private four-guest fixture reached ready.json with the optional bundle omitted and a longer local readiness window. No fencing conclusion follows from fixture readiness.
